assessment.nobel_worthiness: Identification of GLP-1 as an incretin and the translation to long-acting receptor agonists produced one of the largest therapeutic advances of the past decade, with robust outcomes in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular risk. The discovery chain is clear, original and broadly consequential for physiology and medicine.
assessment.attribution: Decisive physiological and molecular contributions are spread across Holst (GLP-1 secretion and action), Drucker (GLP-1 receptor biology, proglucagon processing, clinical concept) and Mojsov (bioactive peptide identification and synthesis). Knudsen is a drug-development contribution and is left out of the three-person configuration, which is a debatable choice. Overlap with other early GLP-1 investigators not on this list is possible and I cannot verify it.
assessment.maturity: Very mature: multiple independent large randomized trials, approvals and real-world data. Recognition is timely, arguably pressing.
uncertainties: Fair division of credit between physiological discovery, peptide chemistry and drug development is contested.
Long-term safety and durability data are still accruing, though this does not undermine the discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically engineered T cells with chimeric antigen receptors created a new class of living drugs and produced durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies. The concept, engineering and clinical proof are original and of lasting impact.
assessment.attribution: June and Sadelain are credited with the decisive second-generation costimulatory CAR design and first clinical proofs in leukemia. Rosenberg's adoptive cell transfer work is foundational but conceptually a distinct contribution. Original CAR concept (e.g. Eshhar) is not among the credited names, so the configuration may be incomplete.
assessment.maturity: Several approved products, independent confirmation across centers and long follow-up; recognition is timely. Toxicity and solid-tumor limits are known.
uncertainties: Credit for the original chimeric receptor concept falls outside the supplied names.
Whether CAR-T and general adoptive cell therapy should be recognized together or separately is unresolved.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Discovery of Wnt/Int-1 as a proviral integration site oncogene and its conserved role in development, stem-cell renewal and cancer is a foundational signaling discovery with deep impact across biology and disease.
assessment.attribution: Nusse and Varmus identified Int-1 and Nusse then led much of the work establishing Wnt signaling; the pair gives a coherent configuration. Contributions from Drosophila wingless genetics and pathway dissection by others are not credited here, and Varmus is already a laureate for a related oncogene discovery.
assessment.maturity: Very mature, extensively confirmed over four decades, with therapeutic efforts still maturing.
uncertainties: Pathway-level credit for Drosophila genetics and downstream components is outside the supplied names.
Varmus having previously received the prize may weigh against a second award.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics transformed causal neuroscience by enabling millisecond-precision control of defined cell populations; it has had wide uptake across systems biology and is moving into clinical vision restoration. A clear methodological discovery with lasting impact.
assessment.attribution: Channelrhodopsin identification and characterization (Nagel, Hegemann, with Bamberg), and the neuronal implementation (Boyden, Deisseroth, also Miesenböck's earlier approach) make attribution genuinely difficult with six credited names. The three proposed names reflect a plausible discovery-plus-application split but exclude Bamberg, Boyden and Miesenböck.
assessment.maturity: Mature in research use and confirmed in thousands of independent studies; clinical translation is early.
uncertainties: Attribution is the central problem with more claimants than three places.
Priority disputes over first neuronal use are not resolved by the supplied text.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle vaccines against HPV prevent persistent infection and cervical precancer and are driving large declines in HPV-related disease, a major preventive-medicine achievement based on a clean mechanistic insight about L1 self-assembly.
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller (L1 VLP formation and immunogenicity) and Frazer (VLP vaccine development) are the core credited names; parallel groups, and the vaccine-manufacturing side, may also claim credit, which I cannot verify.
assessment.maturity: Population-level effectiveness data now support recognition of cancer prevention; timing is strong.
uncertainties: Competing priority claims for VLP vaccine development may exist.
Prior recognition of the HPV-cancer link (zur Hausen) is adjacent but separate.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rational targeting of BCR-ABL with imatinib turned chronic myeloid leukemia into a manageable disease and established the paradigm of molecularly targeted oncology.
assessment.attribution: Lydon (compound program), Druker (preclinical and clinical proof) and Sawyers (resistance mechanisms and next-generation inhibitors) form a defensible set, though the discovery of the Philadelphia fusion itself is not credited here. Industry versus academic attribution is a possible sticking point.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature with decades of survival data and independent replication; recognition is not premature.
uncertainties: The Philadelphia chromosome and BCR-ABL fusion discoveries are outside the supplied credit.
Weight of a drug-development achievement versus mechanistic discovery is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Establishment of long-lived adult stem-cell-derived intestinal organoids opened a general platform for studying tissue renewal, disease modelling and patient-derived testing, with wide impact across fields.
assessment.attribution: Clevers's Lgr5 stem-cell work and Sato's culture system are the decisive contributions and fit a two-person prize naturally. The wider organoid field includes pluripotent-derived work by others, which is not credited here.
assessment.maturity: Widely adopted and independently reproduced; clinical and translational value is still emerging, which makes the medical impact somewhat less proven.
uncertainties: Whether the platform's translational impact is yet established enough for recognition.
Overlap with pluripotent-stem-cell organoid contributions is unclear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Demonstrating TNF as a therapeutic target in rheumatoid arthritis led to anti-TNF biologics that changed treatment of many inflammatory diseases, a clean example of bench-to-bedside discovery.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini jointly led the mechanistic and clinical proof of concept, giving a coherent two-person configuration. Other investigators of TNF biology and antibody engineering are outside the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Very mature with decades of clinical use and biosimilars; recognition is long-standing and could be seen as overdue.
uncertainties: Uncertain whether the committee considers this primarily clinical translation.
Credit for TNF discovery and antibody development lies outside the named pair.
